**Daily Devotional**

**May 2**

*19 For it pleased the Father that in him should all fulness dwell; (Colossians 1:19 KJV)*

This verse makes it clear that everything that God is was in Jesus, and we that are born again, are in Jesus, so we have the entire Godhead in us (Colossians 2:9-10). Wow! That is so awesome. To think that we, who are born again, have access to all that God is (John 1:16). This is of course a clear indication of the deity of Jesus, as He and the Father are one (John 17:21).

We, as Christians, have not even come close to knowing what we have in our new Spirits. Since we have the same power that raised Jesus from the dead (Ephesians 1:19-20), and enabled Him to perform all those miracles, then we can do the same things, if we just find out how to tap into the power of the Holy Spirit within us. We should all be renewing our minds with the Word of God (Romans 12:2), and finding out the rules that govern the use of all that power, so we can do the works that Jesus did, and as He told us to do (John 14:12). Thank you Lord for sharing your power with us, your children.
